title: Ocopy (staff)
body:
Syntax: ocopy <source object vnum> <new object vnum>

Description: Copies an object prototype, including its stats, flags, and programs, to an unused VNUM. The copy is independent of the original. It is not placed or stocked automatically; use 'oinvoke' or 'mset additem' when ready. Inspect it with 'ostat'.

Date: 2026-09-25
